Hi Susan —

Thanks for the invoice and heads up on the split. We can accommodate split remittances, but finance will need clear legal-entity mapping and the correct tax forms before we can release payment. To move this forward please: 

1) Confirm the legal names and EINs for both entities exactly as they appear on tax forms.
2) Provide a signed W-9 for Celestis Biotech, Inc. (US) — PDF with an electronic signature is fine.
3) For the UK entity: either a W-8BEN-E (if you claim US tax treaty benefits) or VAT registration + confirmation that the UK entity is outside US tax reporting. If you expect any 1099 reporting from Redwood, call that out.

Our AP checklist: we need the invoice, signed tax form for the US entity, and a short attestation for the UK entity specifying remit instructions and VAT ID. Once we have those, Marissa will schedule split payments in the next payment run (usually 7 business days after documentation is in the portal).

For your convenience, you can upload docs to the secure portal here: https://hubspot.company/contacts/record/8742 (or reply with attachments). Also include the desired remittance references to appear on the payments (e.g., PO #, invoice line mapping).

I'll leave Marissa on copy to confirm timing. Jonas — tagging for a quick check on whether we need anything else from legal for cross-entity 1099 exposure.

Best,
Kimberly Park
